text.en: Far from Earth, a man replays a recording to hear his mother's voice again.

The story is set in the future on the Moon, in the tunnels of Selenopolis. The son walks with his mother, who is visiting for the first time, and shows her the structures that prop up the star-studded sky. Her ringing voice reflects her love of singing. At the end he plays back a recording and feels as if he is again walking with her on the Moon.
The story is about love between mother and son and about how humanity, like the young, goes out to explore. It ends with the thought that humanity is young.
Learn the words galaxy, chore, orchard, expedition and recording. Notice how a science-fiction setting carries a human emotion.
